headline: Indotel expects to collect RD$5,560 million from Claro and Viettel
summary: The Dominican telecoms regulator Indotel projects net revenue of RD$5,560.42 million from 2026 to 2032 from spectrum concessions to Viettel and Claro Dominicana. Part of the income would fund spectrum oversight and connectivity for health centres and remote communities.
why: Spectrum licences are essential assets for mobile operators, and their fees affect telecom operators' costs and capital planning. Claro Dominicana is part of America Movil's Caribbean network.
original_headline: Indotel espera recaudar RD$5,560 millones de Claro y Viettel
